title: Christmas Nights into Dreams...
overview:
This special edition software supports a calendar feature triggered by the timer built-in to the Sega Saturn. To ensure maximum enjoyment from Christmas NiGHTS, please ensure your Sega Saturn clock is set correctly.

Christmas NiGHTS into Dreams... is a festive one-stage edition of NiGHTS into Dreams. Choose Claris or Elliot, enter the dream world of Nightopia, and fly as NiGHTS through a snow-covered Spring Valley, collecting blue chips, flying through rings and racing the clock before taking on the stage boss.

The game reads the Saturn's clock, so the scenery, music and decorations change with the season and the time of day, with extra surprises on special dates. Clearing the stage and playing a quick matching game unlocks a collection of 25 presents.

- Play as Claris or Elliot (Elliot's course is mirrored)
- Seasonal winter and Christmas versions of the stage
- 25 unlockable presents
